user.title: Connect Reefability
user.description: In the Reefability app open More > Home Assistant > Create token, then paste the token here.

data_description.token: 48 characters, letters a to f and numbers.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Reefability
reauth_confirm.description: The token no longer works (it may have been removed in the app). Create a new one in the Reefability app under More > Home Assistant > Create token and paste it here.

error.invalid_token: That does not look like a Reefability token. It is 48 characters long, using a to f and 0 to 9.
error.invalid_auth: Reefability did not accept this token. Create a new one in the app and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Reefability. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.no_tanks: This account has no tanks yet. Add a tank in the Reefability app first.
error.unknown: Something unexpected happened. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: This token is already set up.

init.title: Send to Reefability
init.description: Choose the tank these Home Assistant sensors belong to. Run this again to link sensors to another tank.

entities.title: Send to Reefability
entities.description: Pick the Home Assistant entities to send to {tank}. Readings are saved about every 10 minutes, and a leak sensor that turns wet sends you an urgent push from Reefability.

probes.name: Tank probes
probes.description: One sensor per parameter. Units are converted for you (for example °C, ppt, meq/L).

data_description.leak: Moisture binary sensors near the tank, sump or reservoir.
data_description.power: Power or energy sensors and smart plugs. Stored for later use.
data_description.other: Anything else worth keeping. Stored for later use.

abort.not_loaded: Reefability is not connected right now. Try again once it is.
abort.no_tanks: This account has no tanks yet.

no_display.message: Feed mode needs a Reefability Display that is online and connected to this tank.

auth_failed.message: Reefability did not accept the token. Reconnect the integration with a new token.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach Reefability ({message}). Try again in a minute.

unknown_tank.message: That is not a Reefability tank.

tank_required.message: Pick a tank (a Reefability device or a tank id).

not_loaded.message: Reefability is not connected right now.

log_reading.name: Log reading
log_reading.description: Saves a test result to a Reefability tank.

tank_id.name: Tank id
tank_id.description: Instead of picking the device, the Reefability tank id.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Optional, for example dKH, meq/L, ppm, °C, °F, ppt or SG. Without it the tank's usual unit is used.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Ticks a Reefability task off. Task ids are listed on the Tasks due today and Tasks overdue sensors.

device_id.name: Tank
device_id.description: Optional, only needed with more than one Reefability account.

ask.name: Ask Reefer AI
ask.description: Asks Reefer AI a short question about a tank and returns the answer.

tank_id.name: Tank id
tank_id.description: Instead of picking the device, the Reefability tank id.

question.name: Question
question.description: What you would like to know.
